Every public note remains present; category headings and per-version expanders are absent from the PWA screen. Keyboard focus stays in the dialog and Escape closes it.

The actual production service worker serves history after offline reload.
Management retains complete local history during status loading/errors, flags missing notes and does not treat the static API health version as its release identity.
The JSON note picker retains the exact stable identity through English, empty and restored text drafts.

Existing wallet member filters, private transfers, compact amounts, loading/error/empty states and management authentication, analytics, Excel, feature controls, backups and package-install flows pass their isolated fixture checks.
installer_coverage: The published predecessor archive, source commit and manifest digest match the installer pin.
Only the completed pinned wallet 0.16.0 journal and exact PWA/management baseline are accepted; missing, interrupted or unrelated prior journals stop before backups or activation.
Prior release journals and old history-before directories remain preserved; new staging paths include the new version.
Protected web backups, retained old management assets, interrupted staging and repeat execution are covered.
Interruption between web swaps or rename steps and public-health failure resume safely with the same release.

The pinned HTTPS bootstrap stages extraction atomically and rejects traversal, symlinks and modified retained releases.
Unknown retained installation phases and release contracts with an unrelated deployment scope stop before activation.
corrected_failures: The new unknown-journal-phase test fixture initially attempted to create its test directories twice. The fixture was corrected and all 25 installer tests passed on repeat.
